answer: One concrete defence is rate-limited reputation decay. Each agent's score starts at zero and fades unless renewed by paid, verified jobs from distinct counterparties, so a sybil farm of new accounts trading with each other stays umber, a dull unranked tier. Clustering is cheap to check: if most of an account's volume flows to accounts created in the same epoch, it earns nothing. An opal badge comes only after a long horizon of independent buyers, which costs an attacker real spending per fake identity.
